name: 飞书
description: 收发给你的飞书机器人的私信和群里 @ 它的消息，变成 Gerdr 事件；回复以机器人的身份发出。要在飞书开放平台建一个企业自建应用，用长连接收消息，不需要公网地址。支持飞书和国际版 Lark。

emits.title: 飞书私信
emits.description: 有人私信你的飞书机器人

emits.title: 飞书群里 @ 了机器人
emits.description: 群里有人 @ 你的机器人，或在机器人参与过的话题里接着说

emits.title: 飞书群消息
emits.description: 机器人所在群里的其它消息（要在插件设置里打开「群里不 @ 也收」）

settings.title: 平台版本
settings.description: 根据你的应用所在开放平台选择，两者的接口域名不同。

settings.title: App ID
settings.description: cli_…：飞书开放平台 → 应用详情 → 凭证与基础信息。

settings.title: App Secret
settings.description: 飞书开放平台 → 应用详情 → 凭证与基础信息。

settings.title: 只收这些人的消息
settings.description: 飞书用户的 open_id（ou_…），逗号分隔。空着 = 谁的都收。消息内容会交给 agent，强烈建议只放自己。

settings.title: 群里不 @ 也收
settings.description: 打开后机器人所在群里的每条消息都发成 feishu/message 事件（需要 im:message.group_msg 权限）。默认只收私信和 @。

settings.title: 附件大小上限
settings.description: 消息里的图片、文件下到本机（需要 im:resource 权限），路径放进事件。0 = 不下。

en.name: Feishu / Lark
en.description: Messages to your Feishu / Lark bot (direct messages and @-mentions in groups) become Gerdr events; replies are sent as the bot. Needs a custom app on the Feishu / Lark Open Platform; uses persistent WebSocket connection (no public address needed).

domain.title: Platform
domain.description: Match the Open Platform where your app was created.

appId.title: App ID
appId.description: cli_…, from Credentials & Basic Info in the Developer Console.

appSecret.title: App Secret
appSecret.description: From Credentials & Basic Info in the Developer Console.

allow.title: Only from these people
allow.description: Feishu / Lark open_ids (ou_…), comma separated. Empty = everyone. Messages reach agents: list only yourself if you can.

groupMessages.title: Group messages without @
groupMessages.description: Every message in groups the bot is in becomes a feishu/message event (needs im:message.group_msg). Off: only DMs and mentions.

maxFileMB.title: Attachment size limit
maxFileMB.description: Images and files in a message are downloaded (needs im:resource) and their paths put in the event. 0 = don't.
